QR1. The bidder shall have supplied 400 kV class or higher rating Current Tran sformers and (optionally) other EHV switchyard equipment such as Circuit Breakers/PTs/CVTs, etc. in India to any PSU/Central Government/State Gov ernment/Steel Industry/Power Plant/ any other process industries within the preceding seven (07) years, reckoned as on the last date of the month prec eding the publication of the NIT, in any of the following manner: a) Single Order of Value not less than INR 16.47 Crore. OR b) Two (2) Orders each of value not less than INR 10.29 Crore OR c) Three (3) Orders each of value not less than INR 08.23 Crore B. The performance of the above supplied Current Transformer(s) should be satisfactory in operation # for a minimum period of two years reckoned as on last date of preceding month of publication of NIT. # Satisfactory operation means certificate issued by the Employer/Utility c ertifying the operation without any adverse remark. In case of contract (s) is /are under execution as on last date of the preceding month of publication of NIT, the value of work executed till such date will be considered pro vided the employer certifies the same. All the work/purchase order value shall be excluding taxes. QR3. The average annual turnover of the bidder in the preceding 03(three) financial years as on last date of the preceding the month of publication of NIT shall not be l ess than INR 20.59 Crore. Note: -Other income shall not be considered while computing annual turnover. In cases where audited results for the last financial year are not available as on last d

ate of the preceding the month of publication of NIT, the financial results certified by a practicing Chartered Accountant shall be considered acceptable. In case, the bidde r is not able to submit the Certificate from a practicing Chartered Accountant certifyi ng its financial parameters, the audited results of three consecutive financial years pr eceding the last financial year shall be considered for evaluating the financial param eters. Further, a certificate would be required from the CEO/CFO as per the format en closed in the bidding documents stating that the financial results of the company are under audit as on last date of the preceding the month of publication of NIT and the Certificate from the practicing Chartered Accountant certifying the financial paramet ers is not available QR4. Net Worth: The net worth of the bidder shall not be less than 100% of its paid -up share capital. In case the bidder meets the requirement of Net Worth based on s trength of its Subsidiary(ies) and/or Holding Company wherever applicable, the Net w orth of the Bidder and its Subsidiary(ies) and/or holding Company, in combined mann er should not be less than 100% of their paid-up share capital.Net worth in combine manner shall be calculated as follows: Net Worth (combined) = (X1+ X2 + X3)/ (Y1+ Y2+Y3)*100.Where X1, X2, X3 are individual net worth which should not be less than 75% of their respective paid-up share capitals and Y1, Y2, Y3 are individual paid up s hare capitals. In Support of QR1: - a) For Manufacturer: Factory License / Third-party Certification / Product Data Sh eet / Technical Manual / any relevant documentary evidence. b) For Authorized Dealer / Distributor / Channel Partner: Tender-specific Authoriz ation Letter issued by the Manufacturer (which Qualify the above criteria of ma nufacturer). c) Any Documentary evidence establishing availability of in-house facilities in In dia for calibration/servicing/repair of minimum 400 kV class Current Transform ers. B. In Support of QR2: - a. Copies of Purchase Order / Award Letter / Work Order/Agreement copies to be submitted along with Completion Certificate / any other document clearly esta blishing scope of supply / work, value of executed work and completion period. b. Certificate from Client as described under notes of QR2 shall also be provided wherever required. c. Performance certificate for Current Transformer. C. Support of QR3 & QR4: - a.
